data.name: Henricks
data.long_meaning: The name Henricks is of Germanic origin, derived from the elements haimo (home) and ric (rule). It translates to 'strong ruler' or 'powerful lord'. This name was popular among the Germanic tribes and was brought to England by the Normans.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing strength and leadership in spiritual matters.
